comments.text:
I literally cried one littre of tears watching this drama but it was one of the best life lesson that I ever had.
When I'm having troubles,difficulties,I'm thinking about this drama, I'm thinking about all the peoples who are suffering from atrocious disease, would like more than anything to live but are condemned to die. 

For these peoples I feel that I just can't complain about lighter problem and want and try to enjoy life as much as I can, just for all these peoples who couldn't live.

comments.text: I cried four to five times watching the tv series alone. The way her health decended. I didn't know what time she lived but she died in 1988 but today with stem cell research people with her diease are getting treated I don't know if it cures the diease but it helps them enjoy a better quality of life and slow down the progression. At first I thought she lived in the 2000's I was so angry I thought if only she had more time today she could have gotten the stem cell treatment but knowing it was 1988 I was able to understand even at that time no longer how long she waited it just as likely back then.
